acceptance: A claude cell cannot read the codex login, and the reverse, and a test proves it on the real sandbox
A cell cannot extract another service's keychain item, also through a copied helper
The design states the model and its review passed
fix: Design from the source, not a longer list: for example, run each cell under a separate OS user or a keychain-less session, or give each family only its own home view (a per-family HOME). Architecture and adversarial review first.
summary: Three design rounds of section 9.2 of docs/architecture/llm-isolation.md (2026-11-11) found credential paths that a list of denied paths and binaries cannot close. The landed part removes the git credential helper from each cell and denies the listed secret files at shadow. Open: a copy of a keychain helper keeps its code identity, and the claude CLI itself uses /usr/bin/security for its login; a rename in a writable parent or a planted symlink moves a secret out of a denied path; the login files of the other model families are readable.
title: Close the credential paths of a cell that a path list cannot close
